_comment: Matches this gate has been told not to fail on.
THE VALUE IS NEVER STORED, and neither is its location. Each entry is a
salted hash of the matched text and nothing else. This file is committed to
a PUBLIC repository: recording which document a hash came from would be a
map to unredacted material, which is exactly what the gate's own reporting
refuses to print. To find an entry, run the gate locally with --detail.
WHAT AN ENTRY MEANS. That this match was reviewed and is not a protected
identifier. It is NOT a backlog and not a deferral: everything here has been
WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT HERE. Every genuinely protected identifier found on
2026-07-31 was resolved by REMOVING the document or withholding the page,
never by being listed here. Social Security numbers, dates of birth, and the
driver's licence and residence data that travelled with them all stand at
zero. So does account_number, once routing numbers were split out of it.
CLEARING AN ENTRY means redacting the source PDF and rebuilding the corpus,
or withdrawing the document. Deleting the line only makes the build red.

note: A test asserts this file contains no entry for any of these.
account_number joined this list on 2026-07-31, when triage found that all
eight of its matches were routing numbers and the true count was zero. It
is an MCR 1.109(D)(9) category, so a future match must be resolved at the
source rather than accepted here. Adding it while the count is zero costs
nothing and closes the door before anyone is under pressure to open it.

accepted.reason: Triaged 2026-07-31 and found not to be an account number. A routing number identifies a financial institution, not a person: it is printed on every cheque and published by the institutions themselves. One of the filings carrying these makes the same point in its own text, and the account numbers alongside them are already reduced to their last four digits at the source.
